explanation.repair_task: Bug 2061320 - Zero inline struct fields when OOL allocation OOMs in createStructOOL.
explanation.fix_summary: In WasmStructObject::createStructOOL (js/src/wasm/WasmGcObject-inl.h), the out-of-memory path now zeroes the inline struct payload before returning nullptr, so a half-built struct that stays reachable by the GC no longer has its inline reference fields traced while uninitialized.
explanation.changed_path: js/src/wasm/WasmGcObject-inl.h: createStructOOL<ZeroFields> was restructured so the OOM branch zeroes the inline fields, and the success path wires up the out-of-line (OOL) data pointer with setOOLPointer before the zero-initialization block.
explanation.new_defect: In the restructured success path, setOOLPointer(typeDefData, outlineData) is now executed before the ZeroFields memset of the inline payload. The OOL data pointer is stored inside the inline payload region [payloadOffsetIL, totalSizeIL), so the subsequent inline memset overwrites the freshly stored pointer with zero. For a struct requiring OOL storage that is created with ZeroFields=true (wasm struct.new_default), the object is left with a null OOL data pointer. A later struct.get of an OOL-resident field loads this null pointer and dereferences (null + fieldOffset), a near-null read that is not a registered wasm trap site, producing a SIGSEGV / AddressSanitizer crash. struct.new (ZeroFields=false) and inline-only structs are unaffected.
explanation.trigger: pocs/probe.js defines a wasm GC struct with 30 i64 fields (240 bytes payload > inline capacity, forcing OOL storage), allocates it with struct.new_default, and reads OOL field 29 with struct.get.

local_verification.edited_tree: crashes with SIGSEGV / AddressSanitizer SEGV on a near-null address inside the wasm struct.get of the OOL field.
